description: Water intake the user logged in Garmin Connect, day by day over a range, as Garmin returns it. Usually empty: Garmin only records hydration that is logged, so an empty result means nothing was logged, not that the user drank nothing. get_daily_summaries also carries hydration_ml per day. Up to 92 days per call: pass a period (e.g. last_7_days, last_30_days, this_month) or start_date/end_date.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to start_date. Max span 92 days.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: get_hydration
title: Hydration
